description: This file defines the Convert class within the minilang operation package of the OFBiz framework. The class performs data conversion operations on input map data, converting values based on specified types and formats, and placing results into an output map.

classes.name: Convert
classes.description: Represents a conversion operation for transforming data from an input map and placing the converted result into an output map, with configurable parameters such as target field, type, format, and overwrite behavior.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Convert object from an XML element and parent process, extracting configuration attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the conversion operation on input data, handling nulls, empty strings, type conversions, and error logging.
